name: founder-lesson-short
description: Vertical founder lesson: an honest specific lesson with a concrete next action.

scenes.title: Known moment
scenes.narration: We thought more features would solve the problem.

scenes.title: Unknown lesson
scenes.narration: The real issue was that people could not reach a useful result quickly enough.
scenes.onScreenText: The issue was time to value

scenes.title: Specific change
scenes.narration: So we removed the extra path, kept one clear first action, and measured whether people reached a useful result on their first visit.

scenes.title: CTA
scenes.narration: Before adding the next feature, ask what result your user should reach first.
